after_commit_message:
[OP-1403] Expand merger context pack

Add a priority-capped merger context pack before the LLM call. The pack includes the full conflict file, recent git intent, JIRA context, sibling file contents, and develop symbol-table data when supplied by the proactive merger path.

Wire the extra fields through orchestrator and arbiter payloads, and teach conflict enrichment/webhooks to collect sibling contents, git logs, symbol tables, change_number, and JIRA descriptions for backend delegation.

[Tier-B]
